data.narrative:
EdgeRunner AI is a Series A defense and security company that has raised $17.5M to date. Our valuation analysis employs two triangulation methods applied across a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at Series A/B stages, supplemented by reference to 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Stage-progression analysis, applying a standard 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $18M total-raised proxy, implies a $35M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company Defense & Security cohort yields a $1.0B median valuation, with a distribution range of $125M to $3.0B. The peer set includes recent Series B companies: Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

Our triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $30M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $518M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around EdgeRunner's market position, technology differentiation, and revenue traction relative to better-capitalized Series B peers. Stage-progression suggests a floor near current raised capital; peer multiples suggest substantially higher valuations typical for the sector. Reconciling this gap requires clarity on EdgeRunner's product-market fit, customer pipeline, and defensibility relative to named competitors.
